pr_title: fix(ivy): match directives on namespaced elements
pr_body:
Prior to this change, namespaced elements such as SVG elements would not
participate correctly in directive matching as their namespace was not
ignored, which was the case with the View Engine compiler. This led to
incorrect behavior at runtime and template type checking.

This commit resolved the issue by ignoring the namespace of elements and
attributes like they were in View Engine.

Fixes #32061

issue_context.title: Issue with directive selector inside SVG when using IVY
issue_context.body:
# 🐞 bug report ### Affected Package IVY Compiler ### Is this a regression? Yes, works fine without IVY ### Description A directive or component with a selector of type 'element[attribute]' and Inputs will not compile under IVY if used inside an SVG template. An attribute selector works as expected. ## 🔬 Minimal Reproduction https://github.com/mitch8/ivy-issue The issue is only present when building with IVY. 

"angularCompilerOptions": {
    "enableIvy": true,
  }
**ng build** works fine **ng build --prod** fail with IVY enabled ## 🔥 Exception or Error If the directive is part of my app I get an error like this. 

ERROR in src/app/app.component.html(4,9): Property 'test' does not exist on type 'HTMLElement'.
Interestingly, if the directive is part of a library from node_modules, it will compile without errors under IVY, however you will then get a runtime error. 

Can't bind to 'test' since it isn't a known property of 'text'
## 🌍 Your Environment **Angular Version:** Angular CLI: 8.2.1 Node: 10.13.0 OS: win32 x64 Angular: 8.2.1 ... animations, cli, common, compiler, compiler-cli, core, forms ... language-service, platform-browser, platform-browser-dynamic ... router Package Version ----------------------------------------------------------- @angular-devkit/architect 0.802.1 @angular-devkit/build-angular 0.802.1 @angular-devkit/build-optimizer 0.802.1 @angular-devkit/build-webpack 0.802.1 @angular-devkit/core 8.2.1 @angular-devkit/schematics 8.2.1 @ngtools/webpack 8.2.1 @schematics/angular 8.2.1 @schematics/update 0.802.1 rxjs 6.4.0 typescript 3.5.3 webpack 4.38.0
comments: This seems to be affecting the popular @swimlane/ngx-charts library, which is using such directives on SVG's and is not working for me at all under Ivy

I seem to be hitting this with our Angular icon package (we also use directives on SVGs, it's pretty core to the functionality of our library). This is the error the compiler gives me: 
![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/1744185/65790376-8143e880-e12d-11e9-9d26-fcae9c7afefa.png)

Which is produced by this code: 
```html
<svg ibmIconAddAlt [size]="'16'"></svg>
```

I can provide a minimal environment if needed 👍
